title: The Row Normalization Puzzle in Muon
abstract: arXiv:2609.39114v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper examines how row-wise renormalization affects Muon, focusing on the gap between NorMuon's worst-case guarantees and its practical performance (Li et al.). Despite its growing adoption and promising performance in large language model (LLM) pretraining, NorMuon's worst-case guarantees remain poorly understood. One fundamental question is: Does row normalization yield provable convergence gains, potentially through its interaction with approximate polar computation and exponential moving-average momentum? Our results show that row normalization introduces a dimension-dependent factor in the worst-case iteration complexity under the operator-norm geometry, which persists even with exact polar computation and any fixed momentum parameters. translated_abstract: 本文研究了逐行重新归一化对Muon优化器的影响，重点关注NorMuon的最坏情况理论保证与其实际性能之间的差距（Li等人）。尽管NorMuon在大语言模型（LLM）预训练中的应用日益广泛且表现令人期待，但其最坏情况下的理论保证仍然缺乏深入理解。一个根本性的问题是：行归一化是否能带来可证明的收敛增益，尤其是通过与近似极分解计算和指数移动平均动量的相互作用？我们的结果表明，在算子范数几何下，行归一化会在最坏情况迭代复杂度中引入一个依赖于维度的因子，即使采用精确的极分解计算和任意固定的动量参数，该因子依然存在。事实上，我们在确定性设置下建立了一个算法依赖的下界和一个相匹配的上界，并将上界分析扩展到随机设置。
tldr: 该论文证明在算子范数几何下，行归一化会在Muon优化器的最坏情况迭代复杂度中引入一个维度依赖因子，且该因子无论使用精确极分解计算还是动量参数都无法消除，作者在确定性和随机设置下分别建立了匹配的上下界来解释这一现象。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that row normalization introduces a dimension-dependent factor in Muon's worst-case iteration complexity under operator-norm geometry—which persists even with exact polar computation and any fixed momentum—and establishes matching algorithm-dependent lower and upper bounds in deterministic settings, extending the upper bound analysis to stochastic settings.
